title: Parents and Siblings
label: ch:spanish-family
canDo: I can name my parents and my siblings in Spanish and explain why hermano is not built on Latin's word for brother.

payoff.summary: Give el padre, la madre, el hermano and la hermana, trace hermano back through germānus to germen, the seed, rather than to frāter, and separate its silent h from the once-spoken h of hijo and hacer.
